# skyhub_service (Resource)

A custom port service (Security > Services) that firewall rules can reference. Changing anything but the name recreates the entry on the hub; rules referencing it briefly lose their target.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "skyhub_service" "ssh_alt" {
  name       = "SvcC"
  protocol   = "tcp"
  start_port = 7003
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Service name, 1-12 characters from `A-Z a-z 0-9 - _`.
- `protocol` (String) `tcp`, `udp` or `tcp_udp`.
- `start_port` (Number) First port (1-65535).

### Optional

- `end_port` (Number) Last port; defaults to `start_port`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The service name.
- `index` (Number) 1-based row index on the hub (informational).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import skyhub_service.ssh_alt SvcC
```
